desc: Sort intervals by right endpoint while keeping original indices.
Compute p[i] = bisect_left(sorted_right_endpoints, l_i) for each sorted interval (strict r < l overlap rule).
Initialize dp[0][0]=(0,()) and dp[0][c]=None for c>0.
For each interval i and c=1..4, compute candidate from dp[p[i]][c-1] by adding weight and inserting original index; set dp[i][c] = better(dp[i-1][c], candidate).
Define better(a,b): higher weight wins; tie broken by lexicographically smaller tuple (Python tuple comparison).
After all intervals, select best among dp[n][c] for c=0..4 and return list of indices.
Run sample tests: Example 1 -> [2,3] PASS; Example 2 -> [1,3,5,6] PASS.
Brute-force stress test over ~20k random cases (all subsets ≤4, small n, many weight ties, equal endpoints, duplicates): zero mismatches.

Spot-check edge cases (n=1, mutually overlapping intervals, shared boundaries counted as overlap, duplicate right endpoints, same-weight cross-cardinality ties) and confirm lexicographic correctness proof.
